acquisition method: A cycle of one full Fourier transformation scan mass spectrum (300−1750 m/z, resolution of 60,000 at m/z 200, AGC target 1e6) was followed by 16 data-dependent MS/MS scans
alkylation reagent: Lyophilized proteins were dissolved in 6 M guanidinium chloride, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, 40 mM chloroacetamide, and 100 mM Tris pH 8.5.
alkylation concentration: Lyophilized proteins were dissolved in 6 M guanidinium chloride, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, 40 mM chloroacetamide, and 100 mM Tris pH 8.5.
cleavage agent: followed by trypsin digestion (1:100) at 37 °C overnight.
collision energy: with a normalized collision energy of 27 eV.
fractionation method: For whole proteome profiling, 90 µg of each sample was fractionated by strong cation exchange (SCX) chromatography.
instrument: coupled online to a Q-Exactive HF Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: Nanoelectrospray was generated by applying 3.5 kV.
labeling: 3785, 3838, and 4200 protein groups could be quantified by label-free quantification in type I, II, and IIM, respectively.
